# `compat/interposers/file-export.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/interposers/file-export.js`

interposers/file-export.js — safe blob/download handling for a guest realm. Guests export files via `URL.createObjectURL(blob)` + an `<a download>` click (or `showSaveFilePicker`). Two problems: created object URLs leak if never revoked, and downloads are invisible to the OS. This shim wraps `URL` so every `createObjectURL` is tracked (and revoked on realm destroy) and each export is counted into the app's metrics — without blocking the legitimate download.
